兄弟 refers to the brothers Lu Ji and Lu Yun.
蔡 refers to Cai Hong (蔡洪) by surname.
諸君 refers collectively to the Wu scholars discussed.
秀才 refers to the person being addressed, likely Cai Hong (蔡洪), a title/office reference.
吳 refers to the people of Wu (吳士), a collective reference to Wu scholars.
吳府君 refers to Wu Zhan (吳展), an honorific/office title reference to a person.
朱永長 refers to Zhu Dan (朱誕), courtesy name 永長.
嚴仲弼 refers to Yan Yin (嚴隱), courtesy name 仲弼.
顧彦先 refers to Gu Rong (顧榮), courtesy name 彦先.
張威伯 refers to Zhang Chang (張畼), courtesy name 威伯.
陸士衡 refers to Lu Ji (陸機), courtesy name 士衡.
